description: Settings sync (R7-#10): versioned settings export/import documents with three-way diff (added/modified/conflict/removed), per-key conflict resolutions, and an optional private-remote push/pull client. Secrets are refused, never synced: any document matching a shared @ai-factory/security secret pattern is rejected at export and at import. Server-only package: the desktop talks to it over HTTP, never imports it.
name: @ai-factory/settingsync
